text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to the cafeteria to take a break—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hhhmmm. Hmmmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Hello, it is I, Troubled-chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is troubled. Mar-chan wants to cook,
but no menu ideas are coming to mind."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It all started a few hours ago—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~♪ This scent is just so nice~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I smell charcoal or BBQ sauce,
it always reminds me of Taiki-san~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Like your smiling face while happily grilling meat, or your startled look when the oil spatters♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see hot pot,
it reminds me of Akebono too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Chanko nabe has such a cute name, and it's warm and relaxing just like Akebono~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. BBQs and chanko nabe
are pretty much synonymous with us, huh~

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Now that is good to know. *sparkle*

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And so, I am trying to think of a dish that will make people say, “Now that's definitely Chan-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is true that people associate others with their favorite foods.
It seems like a good strategy to be remembered, but—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"However... this is quite difficult, you see.
Should the flavor be sweet,
or would savory be better?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you prefer warm or cold?
And what about the shape—round or angular—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Every single one lacks a definitive punch.
Chan-Mei is in a pinch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that's where the problem-solver steps in!
Come now, Trainer-san, decide on a dish
that brings Mar-chan to mind."
choice_data_list: You're leaving it to me to decide!?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse. After all, Trainer-san is
Mar-chan's exclusive lens.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you've been watching Chan-Me this whole time,
a food that feels very Chan-Me should come to mind right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan's dream is to become an
Ultra Super Mascot loved all across the world, but—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even if the whole world remembers Chan-Me, it defeats the purpose if the people closest to me forget.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you come up with a dish for Machan on your own,
you'll surely never forget Machan for the rest of your life.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san,
let's put our all into this.
Without further ado, the dish Chan-me should make is—
choice_data_list: Let's go with your favorite food.
Let's go with your favorite food.
Let's make something with visual impact!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san,
let's put our all into this.
Without further ado, the dish Chan-me should make is—
choice_data_list: Let's go with your favorite food.
Let's go with your favorite food.
Let's make something with visual impact!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, and what's the reasoning behind that?
choice_data_list: If it's something you like, it'll stick in your memory much better.
If you think you like it, it'll stick in your memory even more.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. In that case, let's go with
whatever Mar-chan likes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. What Mar-chan likes
is fish and chips.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I ate this in the UK with my dad a long time ago.
Once I found out it was his favorite, it somehow tasted even better...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Indeed, things loved by the person you love
might be easier to remember.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after making fish and chips
with Aston Machan—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what could it be?
It smells so good, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It really smells so good~
What are you making, Curren-chan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufun.
You want to know? You really want to know, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, go ahead, it's a feast that will be etched into your memory.
We'll eat it together, and turn it into an unforgettable
memory for all of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crispy, delicious deep-fried food. A flavor that
would surely remain in one's memory forever.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case, I have a special trick.
Trainer, please go buy some fish right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I shall create a supreme masterpiece—one you'll remember in an instant and never forget for the rest of your life, yes indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after helping Aston Machan
with her cooking—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Chan-chan! Thanks for reaching out.
I've come to get some snacks♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what an unforgettable snack is like~.
I was really looking forward to it, but—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Bono
text_block_list.text:
Wha-aat?! What's this?!
Whoa, w-what is this~?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, surprised you, didn't it? Memorized it now?
Anyone who sees this once will never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Aston Machan made was a stargazy pie—
a unique pie with fish heads poking out,
gazing up at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the little fish lined up so pretty?
The sweet potato filling is creamy and delicious too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Is something wrong, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, could this be...—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Very strange, and very interesting!
I'm so excited, let's hurry and eat it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. When you think of Chan-Me, you think of this pie.
Please don't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's pie had an overwhelming impact.
Incidentally, it tasted delicious.
